5ff1b406-a231-4d09-a7d3-b1bc13e91de7.title: Angry Birds
5ff1b406-a231-4d09-a7d3-b1bc13e91de7.creator: Rovio; Jaakko Iisalo (designer)
description: Angry Birds turns a slingshot into a tool for small physics puzzles. Players choose the angle and strength of a launch, sending birds into constructions of wood, glass, and stone to eliminate the pigs sheltered inside. Different birds introduce abilities that reward timing as well as aim, while limited ammunition encourages experimentation with weak points and chain reactions.

The original mobile game grew from Jaakko Iisalo’s bird sketches at Rovio. Its brief, repeatable levels made it well suited to touchscreen play, and its success led to sequels, spin-offs, and a broader entertainment franchise. This entry refers to the original 2009 game.
5ff1b406-a231-4d09-a7d3-b1bc13e91de7.imageAlt: Angry Birds — cover or representative image

5dcc9923-44f9-4272-9f1e-b9a8982bc161.title: Assassin’s Creed
5dcc9923-44f9-4272-9f1e-b9a8982bc161.creator: Ubisoft Montreal
description: The original Assassin’s Creed follows Altaïr through a fictionalized Holy Land during the Third Crusade. Missions combine gathering information, approaching a target, carrying out an assassination, and escaping through streets and rooftops. Climbing and blending into crowds make the city itself part of the player’s toolkit.

These historical adventures are framed as memories accessed by Desmond Miles through a machine called the Animus. The competing ideals of Assassins and Templars connect the two periods. This 2007 release established the series’ mixture of historical settings, parkour, and conspiracy fiction.
5dcc9923-44f9-4272-9f1e-b9a8982bc161.imageAlt: Assassin’s Creed — cover or representative image

170657c4-7a80-4198-a540-860c8c2456b9.title: Baseball
170657c4-7a80-4198-a540-860c8c2456b9.creator: No single inventor; developed from earlier bat-and-ball games
description: Baseball alternates two teams between batting and fielding. Batters try to reach base and advance around the diamond to score runs; defenders use pitching, catches, and throws to record outs. The absence of a running game clock gives each pitch its own rhythm, with decisions about positioning, stealing bases, and substitutions shaping play over successive innings.

Modern baseball developed in the nineteenth-century United States from older bat-and-ball traditions. It has no single securely established inventor. Organized leagues standardized many rules, while informal versions continue to adapt the game to smaller fields, fewer players, and improvised equipment.

imageCredit.author: D. Benjamin Miller
imageCredit.description: Tommy Milone gives up a home run to Mike Trout on May 21, 2017.

ae50f377-e500-4377-b418-272ed8a478a5.title: Basketball
ae50f377-e500-4377-b418-272ed8a478a5.creator: James Naismith
description: Basketball is a court game in which teams score by sending a ball through an elevated hoop. Passing and dribbling move the ball into shooting positions, while screens, cuts, and rebounds create new opportunities. Standard full-court play uses five players per side, but playground and other small-team forms are also central to its culture.

James Naismith devised the game in Springfield, Massachusetts, in December 1891 as an indoor activity for his students. Its original peach baskets and simple rules developed into a fast sport in which spacing, coordination, and individual ball skills constantly interact.

imageCredit.author: kris krüg from Vancouver, Canada
imageCredit.description: USA vs. China Mens Basketball - Beijing 2008 Olympic Games

d28ea96a-104c-41eb-afca-16361012d3c9.title: Bioshock
d28ea96a-104c-41eb-afca-16361012d3c9.creator: 2K Boston and 2K Australia; Ken Levine (creative lead)
description: BioShock takes place in Rapture, an underwater city whose promise of freedom has collapsed into violence. The player explores its ruined districts as Jack, combining firearms with genetic powers called plasmids. Hacking security systems, managing resources, and choosing how to approach enemies give encounters several possible solutions.

Much of the city’s history is encountered through its architecture, recordings, and surviving inhabitants. The game connects its dystopian setting to questions about ideology, coercion, and the player’s apparent freedom to act. This entry covers the original 2007 game.

5192100e-1524-4aa4-9367-f79de5b596bc.title: Call of Duty
5192100e-1524-4aa4-9367-f79de5b596bc.creator: Infinity Ward
description: The first Call of Duty presents World War II through American, British, and Soviet campaigns. Rather than consistently treating the player as an isolated hero, its missions surround them with allied soldiers and staged battlefield events. Infantry combat is interspersed with vehicle sequences and objectives tied to the progress of a larger force.

Developed by Infinity Ward for Windows, the 2003 game began the series that later expanded into other periods and settings. Its emphasis on squad presence and cinematic pacing helped define the early franchise’s identity.
5192100e-1524-4aa4-9367-f79de5b596bc.imageAlt: Call of Duty — cover or representative image

a6313e94-1422-4250-8460-a4281f57df75.title: Candy Crush
a6313e94-1422-4250-8460-a4281f57df75.creator: King
description: Candy Crush Saga is a match-three puzzle game built around swapping adjacent sweets to form matching lines. Larger matches produce special pieces that can clear rows, columns, or areas, and combinations of those pieces create chain reactions. Each level sets an objective within a limited number of moves, turning a simple action into a problem of planning and resource use.

This entry focuses on Candy Crush Saga, the 2012 Facebook game that followed King’s earlier Candy Crush browser title. Mobile editions brought its short levels and progression map to touchscreen devices, with optional purchases supporting its free-to-play model.
a6313e94-1422-4250-8460-a4281f57df75.imageAlt: Candy Crush — cover or representative image

03f6f943-3aaa-4f7f-b520-2287e4339fac.title: Chess
03f6f943-3aaa-4f7f-b520-2287e4339fac.creator: No single known inventor
03f6f943-3aaa-4f7f-b520-2287e4339fac.origin: Indian predecessors by the 7th century; modern rules developed in late-15th-century Europe
description: Chess is a two-player strategy game on an eight-by-eight board. Each kind of piece moves differently, and the central objective is to checkmate the opposing king. Because both players can see the whole position and no random device determines moves, play revolves around calculation, pattern recognition, and judging long-term advantages.

The game descends from earlier forms including Indian chaturanga and Persian shatranj. The powerful modern queen and bishop emerged in Europe near the end of the fifteenth century, with further standardization over subsequent centuries. Chess therefore has a long, collective history rather than a single creator or commercial release.

imageCredit.author: Alan Light
imageCredit.description: Chess pieces – left to right: king, rook, queen, pawn, knight and bishop.

5bb8c9a3-9c62-4b57-aaa2-b3f965401737.title: Chibi-Robo
5bb8c9a3-9c62-4b57-aaa2-b3f965401737.creator: Skip Ltd.
description: Chibi-Robo! Plug Into Adventure! casts the player as a tiny household robot living with the Sanderson family. Ordinary domestic spaces become large environments to explore, with furniture to climb, messes to clean, and family members and living toys to help. Actions consume electricity, so finding outlets and managing the robot’s battery are recurring parts of play.

Released first in Japan for the GameCube, the game mixes platforming with errands and character stories. Progress comes through making others happy, giving routine care and small acts of assistance a central role in its adventure.

5f307c05-65b4-4af7-8ec4-73c1b5838cd5.title: Crysis
5f307c05-65b4-4af7-8ec4-73c1b5838cd5.creator: Crytek
description: Crysis places the player in a tropical island conflict that develops into an encounter with an alien force. Its Nanosuit offers enhanced strength, speed, armor, and camouflage, allowing a soldier to switch between direct attacks, stealth, and mobile approaches to the terrain. Broad outdoor combat spaces invite players to choose routes and improvise with weapons, vehicles, and cover.
The original PC release became known both for its demanding graphics and for the flexibility of its combat. This entry concerns the 2007 game, rather than the later remaster or the series as a whole.

1ea2a3ec-faf6-4c5c-bdd2-8db02c6e6979.title: Dance
1ea2a3ec-faf6-4c5c-bdd2-8db02c6e6979.creator: Collective traditions across many cultures
1ea2a3ec-faf6-4c5c-bdd2-8db02c6e6979.origin: Ancient; no single origin or release date
description: Dance organizes bodily movement into expressive, rhythmic, social, or ceremonial forms. It may follow established steps and choreography or develop through improvisation, and it can be performed alone, with a partner, or in groups. Music is a frequent companion, but movement can also establish its own timing.

Dance is included here as a broad field of embodied play rather than one game with a universal rulebook. Social dances, performance traditions, and competitive dancesport place different values on participation, interpretation, technique, and judging. Their histories belong to many communities, so a single inventor or release date would be misleading.

imageCredit.author: Barry Goyette from San Luis Obispo, USA
imageCredit.description: Greg Sample and Jennita Russo of Deyo Dances performing in the modern ballet  Brasileiro.

16b6dbd0-3834-4112-9e53-696adbbb7034.title: Donkey Kong
16b6dbd0-3834-4112-9e53-696adbbb7034.creator: Nintendo; Shigeru Miyamoto and Gunpei Yokoi
description: The original Donkey Kong is an arcade platform game about climbing through a construction site to rescue Pauline. The player controls the character later known as Mario, timing jumps and ladder movements around rolling barrels and other hazards. Its distinct stage layouts make each climb a different arrangement of routes, obstacles, and moving threats.

Designed at Nintendo under Shigeru Miyamoto and Gunpei Yokoi, the game introduced characters that became central to Nintendo’s identity. This entry refers to the 1981 arcade title, rather than the later Donkey Kong Country games.
16b6dbd0-3834-4112-9e53-696adbbb7034.imageAlt: Donkey Kong — cover or representative image

285d4905-306e-4c9c-ba78-256df7ea3781.title: Doom
285d4905-306e-4c9c-ba78-256df7ea3781.creator: id Software
description: Doom sends a space marine through demon-infested bases and otherworldly spaces. Fast movement, weapon choice, and reading enemy attacks matter as much as aiming; levels also ask players to locate keys, switches, exits, and hidden areas. Its mixture of technological and infernal imagery makes the environment part of the game’s escalating rhythm.

The 1993 PC game circulated through a shareware model and supported networked cooperative play and deathmatch. Its editable WAD data files helped sustain a large community of custom maps and modifications. This entry covers that original game.

312d6ee7-41d3-42ce-b8dc-1c86eb08e122.title: Dungeons & Dragons
312d6ee7-41d3-42ce-b8dc-1c86eb08e122.creator: Gary Gygax and Dave Arneson
312d6ee7-41d3-42ce-b8dc-1c86eb08e122.publisher: TSR (original); Wizards of the Coast (later editions)
description: Dungeons & Dragons is a tabletop role-playing game in which players portray adventurers in a shared fantasy world. A Dungeon Master describes situations, plays other characters, and adjudicates the rules, while the group decides how to explore, negotiate, fight, and solve problems. Dice introduce uncertainty, but much of the activity takes place through conversation and collective imagination.

Created by Gary Gygax and Dave Arneson and first published by TSR in 1974, D&D grew from miniature wargaming into a model for sustained character-based campaigns. Its many editions change particular mechanics, while retaining the interplay between written rules and a group’s unfolding story.
312d6ee7-41d3-42ce-b8dc-1c86eb08e122.imageAlt: Dungeons & Dragons — cover or representative image

imageCredit.author: Philip Mitchell
imageCredit.description: Dungeons & Dragons game in progress. Miniatures from Dungeons & Dragons Miniatures Game and others on Master Maze scenery by Dwarven Forge. Around the dungeon can be seen many multi-sided dice, a character sheet (bottom left) and a D&D manual (top right). Note that the circular template at the bottom is not from Dungeons & Dragons, but rather is from the futuristic wargame Warhammer 40,000.

79e18161-ce08-44f3-bc75-38464cf02996.title: Exquisite Corpse
79e18161-ce08-44f3-bc75-38464cf02996.creator: Surrealist artists and writers
description: Exquisite Corpse is a collaborative drawing or writing game in which participants add to a work without seeing all of the earlier contributions. A folded sheet can conceal each section while leaving a few connecting marks or words visible. Unfolding it reveals a composition that no single participant planned.

Associated with Surrealist circles in 1920s Paris, the game turns restricted information and chance into tools for collective invention. It has no fixed winning condition: the unexpected whole, and the group’s response to it, are the point of the activity.
79e18161-ce08-44f3-bc75-38464cf02996.imageAlt: Exquisite Corpse — cover or representative image

imageCredit.author: Ericaparrott
imageCredit.description: Exquisite corpse (cadavre exquis) drawing by Noah Ryan and Erica Parrott, from Exquisite Corpse Zine img

75a30a19-83a5-47ff-9a76-f831b3741fdb.title: Fishing
75a30a19-83a5-47ff-9a76-f831b3741fdb.creator: No single inventor
75a30a19-83a5-47ff-9a76-f831b3741fdb.origin: Long-established practice; recreational traditions vary by region
description: Recreational fishing makes the pursuit of fish an activity of leisure, skill, and sometimes competition. Angling commonly uses a rod, line, hook, and bait or an artificial lure, but the wider practice includes several other methods. Reading water, weather, and animal behavior can be as important as casting technique.

Unlike a single designed game, fishing has no universal scoring system or inventor. Some participants value a catch, others the experience of waiting and observing, and organized events establish their own measures of success. It is distinct from fishing primarily for subsistence or commercial production.

imageCredit.author: Foto: Jonn Leffmann
imageCredit.description: En man metar i solnedgången vid Ystads småbåtshamn 2 sep 2018.

228f16dd-d582-48b9-a987-a0c996442fac.title: Football
228f16dd-d582-48b9-a987-a0c996442fac.creator: Collective development; Walter Camp was a major rules contributor
228f16dd-d582-48b9-a987-a0c996442fac.origin: 19th-century United States; major rules changes from 1880
description: This entry uses Football to mean American football, since association football has its own Soccer entry. Two teams attempt to advance an oval ball into the opponent’s end zone, using runs and passes while a defense tries to stop them. The offense normally has four downs to gain ten yards and renew its opportunity to keep possession.

The sport developed from nineteenth-century rugby and football traditions in the United States. Walter Camp was an important contributor to rules such as the line of scrimmage and the downs system, but it was not a one-person invention. Play combines specialized roles, rehearsed formations, and decisions made under pressure.

imageCredit.author: Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Michael A. Lantron, USN
imageCredit.description: Arizona Cardinals wide receiver Larry Fitzgerald catches a touchdown pass from New Orleans Saints quarterback Drew Brees during the fourth quarter of the National Football League Pro Bowl Feb. 8, 2009, at Aloha Stadium in Honolulu. VIRIN: 090208-N-9758L-854

d4635683-4b5a-4d8e-850f-93109857e890.title: Fortnite
d4635683-4b5a-4d8e-850f-93109857e890.creator: Epic Games
description: Fortnite brings several forms of online play into a shared visual and technical world. Save the World combines cooperative combat with building defenses, while Battle Royale places players in a shrinking arena where survival, equipment, positioning, and, in its building modes, construction shape each encounter.

Its later creative tools expanded Fortnite into a platform for player-made spaces and experiences. The release dates here distinguish the original 2017 cooperative early-access launch from the separate arrival of Battle Royale, rather than assigning every part of Fortnite a single launch date.

972bafcb-79c2-461b-8542-a1d0b8dd73ba.title: Grand Theft Auto
972bafcb-79c2-461b-8542-a1d0b8dd73ba.creator: DMA Design
description: The original Grand Theft Auto views its cities from above. Players move between walking and driving, accept criminal assignments, and accumulate points while navigating traffic and police attention. Missions coexist with a relatively open urban space, allowing detours and disruptive improvisation rather than a strictly linear route through every task.

Created by DMA Design, the 1997 game established fictional cities and a structure that later Grand Theft Auto releases developed in three dimensions. Its original publisher was BMG Interactive; the later Rockstar identity should not be projected backward onto that first release.
972bafcb-79c2-461b-8542-a1d0b8dd73ba.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto — cover or representative image

46452ebe-1d67-4f22-b12c-b69a0cdae7b1.title: Guitar Hero
46452ebe-1d67-4f22-b12c-b69a0cdae7b1.creator: Harmonix
description: Guitar Hero translates rock performance into a rhythm game played with a guitar-shaped controller. Players hold fret buttons and strum as notes reach a target line, maintaining timing through increasingly demanding patterns. The controller does not reproduce ordinary guitar technique, but it gives performance a physical, theatrical quality beyond pressing buttons on a standard pad.

The first game appeared on PlayStation 2 in 2005. Its mixture of familiar songs, difficulty levels, and performance feedback made practice and mastery legible to players while also making the game entertaining to watch.
46452ebe-1d67-4f22-b12c-b69a0cdae7b1.imageAlt: Guitar Hero — cover or representative image

6b859622-718c-4056-afc7-13492d0da282.title: Half-Life
6b859622-718c-4056-afc7-13492d0da282.creator: Valve
description: Half-Life follows physicist Gordon Freeman after an experiment at Black Mesa opens the facility to hostile creatures. The player moves through laboratories, service spaces, and outdoor areas, using weapons alongside environmental puzzles and exploration. Encounters with survivors and military forces gradually reveal the scale of the disaster.

Valve presents much of the story through events that occur around the player rather than repeatedly cutting away to separate cinematics. That continuity links combat, navigation, and narrative into a journey through one unfolding crisis. This entry concerns the original 1998 release.

fbacd42f-5ab6-4dd0-9884-c9edcf4e6d43.title: Halo
fbacd42f-5ab6-4dd0-9884-c9edcf4e6d43.creator: Bungie
description: Halo: Combat Evolved follows Master Chief and the artificial intelligence Cortana onto an immense ring-shaped world. Fighting the Covenant involves alternating between infantry encounters and vehicles, managing a regenerating shield, and choosing which two weapons to carry. Open combat areas contrast with enclosed installations and the discoveries inside them.

Released with the Xbox in 2001, the game combined a science-fiction campaign with cooperative and competitive multiplayer. This entry uses the shorter title Halo for the original Combat Evolved, while recognizing that the name also identifies a much larger series.

cbe0aa59-ccdb-45f8-b169-bbea72acce16.title: Hunting
cbe0aa59-ccdb-45f8-b169-bbea72acce16.creator: No single inventor
cbe0aa59-ccdb-45f8-b169-bbea72acce16.origin: Prehistoric; sporting traditions developed across cultures
description: Hunting involves locating and pursuing wild animals, and can serve subsistence, livelihood, cultural, or recreational purposes. Its sporting forms emphasize abilities such as tracking, observation, patience, and familiarity with a landscape. Equipment, quarry, customs, and the meaning attached to a successful hunt vary considerably.

This is a broad practice rather than one designed game. Its place in a collection about play concerns the transformation of pursuit into recreation, ritual, or competition, without treating every form of hunting as sport. No single creator, publisher, or release date applies.

imageCredit.author: FieldsportsChannel.tv
imageCredit.description: British professional hunter Paul Childerley on a driven deer hunt organized by the outfitter "Kartanon Riista" on the "Kytäjän Kartano" hunting estate, west of en:Hyvinkää, Finland, 2017

7a89b432-a8ed-4def-940e-1ddde74e765c.title: Ice Hockey
7a89b432-a8ed-4def-940e-1ddde74e765c.creator: Collective development in Canada and earlier stick-and-ball traditions
7a89b432-a8ed-4def-940e-1ddde74e765c.origin: Modern organized form: 19th-century Canada; Montreal indoor game, 1875
description: Ice hockey is played on skates, with teams using sticks to move a puck and shoot it into a goal. Rapid transitions, passing lanes, and positional coordination shape play, while substitutions allow teams to sustain a high pace. Standard full-strength play puts five skaters and a goaltender on each side.

The modern organized sport developed in Canada from several earlier traditions. An indoor game held in Montreal in 1875 is an important landmark in its recorded history, rather than proof of a single moment of invention. Competitive rules standardize rink markings, periods, penalties, and equipment.

imageCredit.author: Keith Allison from Hanover, MD, USA
imageCredit.description: Bryan Rust of the Pittsburgh Penguins scores a goal against the Washington Capitals in Game Seven of the Eastern Conference Second Round during the 2017 NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs at Verizon Center on May 10, 2017 in Washington, DC.

d3d57ee9-2457-4981-a28e-a4d2c21389c6.title: Lego
d3d57ee9-2457-4981-a28e-a4d2c21389c6.creator: The LEGO Group; Ole Kirk Christiansen and Godtfred Kirk Christiansen
description: LEGO is a construction system built around reusable interlocking pieces. A set can be assembled from instructions, redesigned, or combined with other pieces to make something unrelated to the original model. This balance between a provided design and open-ended recombination supports building, storytelling, collecting, and collaborative play.

The company began producing plastic building bricks in 1949, drawing on earlier interlocking-brick designs. The modern stud-and-tube coupling system followed in 1958. Those dates describe the toy system rather than the company’s founding or any one LEGO set.

9116ee19-4417-41ba-abb4-fc134e59847d.title: LittleBigPlanet
9116ee19-4417-41ba-abb4-fc134e59847d.creator: Media Molecule
description: LittleBigPlanet is a platform game with the appearance of a handmade world of fabric, cardboard, and found objects. Players guide Sackboy through levels whose moving parts and physical materials are also building blocks for making new spaces. Its editor lets players arrange scenery, hazards, mechanisms, and challenges using many of the same ideas encountered in the campaign.

The original PlayStation 3 game organized its identity around playing, creating, and sharing. Its historical significance includes that connection between authored levels and player construction; the original online sharing service is no longer available.

50e9bf32-1234-4249-a7e0-131a030cb95f.title: Magic: The Gathering
50e9bf32-1234-4249-a7e0-131a030cb95f.creator: Richard Garfield
description: Magic: The Gathering combines a card game with the construction of the deck used to play it. Lands provide mana, which pays for creatures, spells, and other effects; players seek ways to overcome an opponent’s defenses and win, often by reducing their life total to zero. Timing and interactions between cards can turn a small change in the board into a major advantage.

Richard Garfield designed the game, first published by Wizards of the Coast in 1993. Its expandable card pool supports many formats, so the permitted cards, deck-building restrictions, and multiplayer arrangements depend on the version being played.
50e9bf32-1234-4249-a7e0-131a030cb95f.imageAlt: Magic: The Gathering — cover or representative image

ccc1bdfd-5ffe-44d9-bf26-f989dc3b942f.title: Mixed Martial Arts
ccc1bdfd-5ffe-44d9-bf26-f989dc3b942f.creator: No single inventor; developed from multiple fighting traditions
ccc1bdfd-5ffe-44d9-bf26-f989dc3b942f.origin: Modern competitive forms developed during the 20th century
description: Mixed martial arts combines striking and grappling within one combat sport. Competitors move between distance fighting, clinches, takedowns, and ground positions, so success depends on connecting skills that other disciplines may practice separately. Bouts can be decided by a finish or by judges under the rules of the event.

Modern MMA developed through cross-style competition and several regional traditions, including Brazilian vale tudo. It should not be reduced to the invention of one promoter or organization. Different organizations and historical periods have used different rules, even as regulated competition has developed shared conventions.

imageCredit.author: Bad intentionz
imageCredit.description: Picture of fighters Shane Carwin and Junior Dos Santos facing off at UFC 131 in Vancouver, Canada.

ab465676-abec-4ce8-92da-09c08a88badc.title: Monopoly
ab465676-abec-4ce8-92da-09c08a88badc.creator: Lizzie Magie (predecessor); Charles Darrow and earlier community variants
description: Monopoly turns movement around a board into a contest over property, rent, and cash flow. Players buy and trade locations, complete color groups, and build houses or hotels that make future visits more expensive for opponents. Dice and event cards introduce uncertainty, while bargaining and decisions about reserves shape the longer contest.

The familiar commercial game has a history extending back to Lizzie Magie’s The Landlord’s Game and many community-made variants. Charles Darrow’s version was published by Parker Brothers in 1935. That lineage matters: a game often associated with accumulating wealth developed from a predecessor intended to criticize the effects of land monopoly.

031ad11d-5602-495e-ba98-670130613ac2.title: Okami
031ad11d-5602-495e-ba98-670130613ac2.creator: Clover Studio; Hideki Kamiya (director)
description: Ōkami follows the sun goddess Amaterasu in the form of a white wolf through a world drawn from Japanese mythology and folklore. Exploration, combat, and helping inhabitants restore damaged places are linked by the Celestial Brush, which lets players draw gestures onto the scene to affect it.

Its ink-painting-inspired appearance is more than a surface style: drawing becomes one of the central ways to act. Developed by Clover Studio and first released for PlayStation 2 in Japan in 2006, the game combines a large adventure with a playful relationship between images and the world they represent.

af513933-9d43-47f8-98a0-12df5c9290f5.title: Overwatch
af513933-9d43-47f8-98a0-12df5c9290f5.creator: Blizzard Entertainment
description: The original Overwatch was a team-based shooter in which players selected heroes with markedly different weapons, movement abilities, and support tools. Its six-player teams competed over objectives such as escorting a payload or holding territory. Choosing complementary heroes and adapting to the opposing team were as important as individual accuracy.

Blizzard released the game in 2016 and expanded its roster and maps over time. This entry describes that original version; its live service was replaced by Overwatch 2 in 2022, so the original game’s team structure should not be confused with every later form of Overwatch.

8ea55ed5-f1ba-43f8-8b39-e6cf70dedc5b.title: Pac-Man
8ea55ed5-f1ba-43f8-8b39-e6cf70dedc5b.creator: Namco; Toru Iwatani (designer)
description: Pac-Man asks the player to clear a maze of dots while avoiding four pursuing ghosts. Power pellets briefly reverse the relationship between hunter and hunted, opening opportunities to eat ghosts for extra points. Routes that look safe can become traps, making anticipation and an understanding of the ghosts’ behavior central to sustained play.

Toru Iwatani designed the arcade game at Namco. Its readable characters, compact rules, and alternating moments of pursuit and escape gave it an identity distinct from the space-shooting games prominent around its 1980 debut.

f2185aa9-1d37-4b68-9b54-62e4ad8ce085.title: Pong
f2185aa9-1d37-4b68-9b54-62e4ad8ce085.creator: Allan Alcorn; Atari
description: Pong reduces a table-tennis-like contest to two vertical paddles and a moving square ball. Players turn a control to intercept the ball and send it back, scoring when the opponent misses. The spare presentation makes the relationship between hand movement, screen position, and the next bounce immediately visible.

Allan Alcorn built the game at Atari, initially as a training assignment. Its successful arcade release in 1972 helped establish a commercial market for videogames. Pong was not the first videogame, and its design followed an electronic table-tennis game on the Magnavox Odyssey.

imageCredit.author: Chris Rand
imageCredit.description: Pong cabinet signed by Pong creator Allan Alcorn in the 'Golden Age of Video Games' exhibit at Neville Public Museum in Green Bay, Wisconsin.

39112d38-b2c5-4166-89b3-dda46a89df59.title: Prince of Persia
39112d38-b2c5-4166-89b3-dda46a89df59.creator: Jordan Mechner
description: The original Prince of Persia is a platform adventure about escaping a dungeon and reaching a captive princess before time runs out. Jumps, ledge grabs, sword fights, and traps require deliberate control: the protagonist’s momentum and vulnerability make a short stretch of corridor feel consequential.

Jordan Mechner used filmed movement as a reference for rotoscoped animation, helping give the character an unusual sense of weight and continuity. Released first for the Apple II in 1989, the game began a series that later reinterpreted its setting and movement systems.

9a81ddaf-80c8-4da2-82cd-390a01b4d152.title: Quake
9a81ddaf-80c8-4da2-82cd-390a01b4d152.creator: id Software
description: Quake sends the player through military facilities and gothic spaces connected by slipgates. Its encounters combine projectile weapons, dangerous creatures, environmental hazards, and fast movement through three-dimensional levels. The dark architecture and unsettling sound design give its science-fiction premise the atmosphere of a horror adventure.

The 1996 game brought fully polygonal environments and enemies to id Software’s shooter design and became influential in networked deathmatch and modification communities. Its original shareware release preceded the retail edition; this entry refers to the first Quake rather than its sequels.

07e3bb60-894f-4436-b436-509b24791a8b.title: Quantum Break
07e3bb60-894f-4436-b436-509b24791a8b.creator: Remedy Entertainment
description: Quantum Break follows Jack Joyce after a failed experiment gives him time-manipulation powers. Gunfights incorporate temporary time stops, rapid movement, and protective effects, while exploration sequences use unstable time as an environmental puzzle. The conflict centers on the consequences of the experiment and competing attempts to respond to them.

Remedy combines playable chapters with live-action episodes that show other sides of the story. Decisions at junction points affect material in those episodes, making the game an experiment in linking an action game with a television-style production.
07e3bb60-894f-4436-b436-509b24791a8b.imageAlt: Quantum Break — cover or representative image

57beacc8-b89b-4573-bbb1-1bf8236fb987.title: Rock Band
57beacc8-b89b-4573-bbb1-1bf8236fb987.creator: Harmonix
description: Rock Band turns a song into a coordinated group performance. Players take guitar, bass, drum, or vocal parts, following visual cues and maintaining timing or pitch with instrument-shaped controllers and a microphone. Different difficulty levels allow people with unequal experience to participate in the same performance.

The first game was developed by Harmonix and released in 2007. Its emphasis on an ensemble shifted the social experience from a single guitar solo toward shared rhythm, recovery from mistakes, and the spectacle of playing together.
57beacc8-b89b-4573-bbb1-1bf8236fb987.imageAlt: Rock Band — cover or representative image

4e8329a9-60ff-4603-bc70-2fc9c5d19b70.title: Rock/Paper/Scissors
4e8329a9-60ff-4603-bc70-2fc9c5d19b70.creator: Traditional; no single known inventor
4e8329a9-60ff-4603-bc70-2fc9c5d19b70.origin: Earlier Chinese hand games; modern form developed in Japan
description: Rock/Paper/Scissors is a simultaneous-choice hand game with a circular relationship between its three options: rock beats scissors, scissors beats paper, and paper beats rock. Matching choices produce a tie. No option is always strongest, so repeated rounds can involve reading habits, creating expectations, and resisting predictable patterns.

It is also used to settle everyday choices without equipment. The familiar three-sign form developed through Japanese hand-game traditions with earlier Chinese precedents, and spread internationally; it has no single commercial publisher or release date.

07dd70cd-be4d-4efb-bb52-3e23e1f757d4.title: Simon
07dd70cd-be4d-4efb-bb52-3e23e1f757d4.creator: Ralph H. Baer and Howard J. Morrison; Lenny Cope (programming)
description: Simon is an electronic memory game with four illuminated colored buttons, each associated with a tone. The device plays a sequence and the player repeats it; successful repetitions extend the pattern. Difficulty comes from remembering and reproducing an increasingly long order rather than discovering a new rule.

Designed by Ralph Baer and Howard Morrison, with programming by Lenny Cope, Simon was launched by Milton Bradley in 1978. Its combination of sound, light, and touch makes memory into a visible and audible performance that can be played alone or shared with others.

372dfce2-b8d2-4bf3-9df3-34f8437480b0.title: Soccer
372dfce2-b8d2-4bf3-9df3-34f8437480b0.creator: Collective development; The Football Association codified rules
description: Soccer, or association football, is a team game organized around moving a ball into the opponent’s goal. Players primarily use their feet, with passing, dribbling, positioning, and coordinated movement creating attacking opportunities. Standard outdoor play uses eleven players per side, including a goalkeeper with special handling privileges within the penalty area.

The Football Association’s 1863 rules were an important step in distinguishing association football from other football codes. The game itself developed collectively from earlier traditions, and informal versions adapt its recognizable goals and movement to streets, small pitches, and widely varying numbers of players.

3b1c2033-fed1-4a77-8bc5-2b16c3add06f.title: Space Invaders
3b1c2033-fed1-4a77-8bc5-2b16c3add06f.creator: Taito; Tomohiro Nishikado
description: Space Invaders places a horizontally moving cannon beneath ranks of descending aliens. Players fire through gaps and use destructible shields for cover, trying to clear each formation before it reaches them. As the formation thins and speeds up, the same simple controls demand increasingly precise timing.

Tomohiro Nishikado designed the game at Taito, including the hardware needed to realize it. Its 1978 arcade release helped establish the fixed shooter as a major form of videogame play, with repeated waves and score chasing providing the central structure.
3b1c2033-fed1-4a77-8bc5-2b16c3add06f.imageAlt: Space Invaders — cover or representative image

e5991f0c-a539-4405-9360-f4f627737241.title: Spec Ops: The Line
e5991f0c-a539-4405-9360-f4f627737241.creator: Yager Development
description: Spec Ops: The Line follows Captain Martin Walker and a small military team into a Dubai devastated by sandstorms. Its third-person combat uses cover, squad commands, and environmental hazards, but the campaign increasingly places pressure on the player’s expectations of a heroic military rescue.

The story draws on the journey into moral disintegration associated with Heart of Darkness and Apocalypse Now. Rather than simply celebrating effective combat, it asks how obedience, interpretation, and the desire to keep progressing can become entangled with destructive actions.
e5991f0c-a539-4405-9360-f4f627737241.imageAlt: Spec Ops: The Line — cover or representative image

81e98792-136c-47b7-8e08-4d8867db71f5.title: Street Fighter
81e98792-136c-47b7-8e08-4d8867db71f5.creator: Capcom; Takashi Nishiyama and Hiroshi Matsumoto
description: The first Street Fighter presents a succession of one-on-one fights, with Ryu as its central playable fighter and Ken available to a second player. Movement, attack timing, and command-based special moves provide the basis of its combat, including techniques that would become signatures of the series.

Capcom’s 1987 arcade game introduced the name and several core ideas, but Street Fighter II later greatly expanded the selectable cast and competitive format. This entry distinguishes the original release from that better-known sequel.
81e98792-136c-47b7-8e08-4d8867db71f5.imageAlt: Street Fighter — cover or representative image

6e17c123-5b13-4e59-ae60-910445ec7d0a.title: Super Mario
6e17c123-5b13-4e59-ae60-910445ec7d0a.creator: Nintendo; Shigeru Miyamoto and Takashi Tezuka
description: Super Mario is a platform-game series centered on movement through spaces filled with enemies, gaps, secrets, and power-ups. Its first installment, Super Mario Bros., sends Mario and Luigi through the Mushroom Kingdom, using jumping and momentum to turn a small set of controls into many kinds of challenge.

Released for the Famicom in Japan in 1985, Super Mario Bros. establishes ideas that later games vary in both two and three dimensions. The date here marks the start of the Super Mario series, not Mario’s earlier debut in Donkey Kong.
6e17c123-5b13-4e59-ae60-910445ec7d0a.imageAlt: Super Mario — cover or representative image

ce9c0f97-1edc-41db-bbc4-f3ba559e9518.title: Super Meat Boy
ce9c0f97-1edc-41db-bbc4-f3ba559e9518.creator: Team Meat; Edmund McMillen and Tommy Refenes
description: Super Meat Boy is a precision platformer built from short, dangerous levels. Players run, jump, and cling to walls while avoiding saws, spikes, and other hazards on the way to Bandage Girl. Rapid restarts make failure part of practice, encouraging repeated attempts until a sequence of movements becomes reliable.

Edmund McMillen and Tommy Refenes developed the game as Team Meat, following the earlier browser game Meat Boy. Its tight movement and brief stages make demanding execution feel like an ongoing process of learning rather than a long return to a distant checkpoint.
ce9c0f97-1edc-41db-bbc4-f3ba559e9518.imageAlt: Super Meat Boy — cover or representative image

a13a4790-85a8-4399-bdd9-623bb5d55532.title: Tetris
a13a4790-85a8-4399-bdd9-623bb5d55532.creator: Alexey Pajitnov
a13a4790-85a8-4399-bdd9-623bb5d55532.publisher: No original commercial publisher; later editions have multiple publishers
description: Tetris is a falling-block puzzle in which players rotate and position four-square pieces to complete horizontal lines. Completed lines disappear, creating space for further pieces; gaps and badly placed blocks make future placements harder. The game’s pressure comes from balancing immediate survival with the shape of the pile being built.

Alexey Pajitnov created the original at a Soviet computing center before it spread through computer copies and commercial editions. The official history dates its creation to 1984, although some historical accounts place completion in 1985. Its many later versions differ in controls and extra systems while retaining the line-clearing core.

8a1ba0fd-6b50-49cb-9aa1-8457a17945d7.title: The Last of Us
8a1ba0fd-6b50-49cb-9aa1-8457a17945d7.creator: Naughty Dog; Neil Druckmann and Bruce Straley (directors)
description: The Last of Us follows Joel and Ellie across a United States transformed by a fungal pandemic. Encounters combine stealth, improvised tools, scavenging, and direct combat, with limited supplies making avoidance or preparation meaningful. Quiet stretches of travel and conversation connect the danger to the changing relationship between its two central characters.
Naughty Dog released the original game for PlayStation 3 in 2013. This entry concerns that release rather than its later remaster, remake, sequel, or television adaptation.

39ee7cbe-d7ce-422b-bfd7-a91c524b1188.title: The Legend of Zelda
39ee7cbe-d7ce-422b-bfd7-a91c524b1188.creator: Nintendo; Shigeru Miyamoto and Takashi Tezuka
description: The original Legend of Zelda sends Link across Hyrule to recover fragments of the Triforce of Wisdom and rescue Princess Zelda. An overworld connects dungeons, hidden entrances, shops, and other discoveries, while weapons and tools expand what the player can do. Exploration depends on remembering places and testing possibilities as much as defeating enemies.

Released first for Japan’s Famicom Disk System in 1986, it established an adventure structure in which a broad landscape and more tightly arranged dungeons inform one another. This entry refers to the first game in the series.
39ee7cbe-d7ce-422b-bfd7-a91c524b1188.imageAlt: The Legend of Zelda — cover or representative image

bfcf3b65-18ad-4b89-b04a-3a9c1baede49.title: Track & Field
bfcf3b65-18ad-4b89-b04a-3a9c1baede49.creator: Collective athletic traditions
bfcf3b65-18ad-4b89-b04a-3a9c1baede49.origin: Ancient precedents; modern organized forms developed in the 19th century
description: Track and field groups contests of running, jumping, and throwing within a shared athletics setting. Races compare finishing times and order, while field events measure height or distance. Combined events test performance across several disciplines rather than one specialty.

Although running and throwing contests have ancient histories, modern track and field developed through standardized events, equipment, measurement, and organized competition. It is a family of sports rather than a single game, so there is no one creator, publisher, or release date.

aa3a5fc9-332c-4db7-adb0-20ee700c1816.title: Train
aa3a5fc9-332c-4db7-adb0-20ee700c1816.creator: Brenda Romero
description: Train is a handmade board game by Brenda Romero in which players initially compete to transport passengers efficiently. Its central revelation—that these journeys lead to Nazi concentration camps—changes the meaning of the actions the players have been taking. The work concerns the Holocaust and the relationship between procedures, obedience, and complicity.

Part of Romero’s The Mechanic Is the Message series, Train uses participation to make players confront a system from within. It is an artist-made work rather than a mass-market railway game, and its purpose cannot be separated from the historical violence it asks players to recognize.

babcd0ee-0b94-4794-8e66-42626fedbb7f.title: Wii Sports
babcd0ee-0b94-4794-8e66-42626fedbb7f.creator: Nintendo EAD
description: Wii Sports collects simplified versions of tennis, baseball, bowling, golf, and boxing around the Wii Remote’s motion controls. Players swing, aim, or punch with gestures that resemble the represented activity, while the software handles much of the complexity of positioning and rules. Mii characters make local matches feel personal and immediately readable.

Released alongside the Wii in 2006 and bundled with it in many markets, the collection introduced the console through shared, physical play. Its approachable controls made the living room and the movements of the players an important part of the experience.
babcd0ee-0b94-4794-8e66-42626fedbb7f.imageAlt: Wii Sports — cover or representative image
